title: Credentials setup on Microsoft Fabric Mirroring in Business Central
summary: Setting up credentials for Microsoft Fabric Mirroring in Business Central 29.1 requires configuring either Microsoft's first-party app or a custom app registration with appropriate permissions and secrets.
key_points: Fabric Mirroring is available in preview from Business Central 29.1
You can use Microsoft's first-party app, or your own app registration if the first-party app has constraints or does not work
An own app registration needs the required permissions, admin consent granted, and a client secret plus client ID
The principal ID is the object ID found under Managed application in local directory
Personalize Business Central to show and enable the custom app registration field, then add the app to the Fabric workspace manually or with the Add to workspace action

quotes.text: Since Business Central 29.1 update it out and you can use the Microsoft Fabric Mirroring (preview) is out
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the version requirement and that the feature is in preview status
